_comment: Every region the project can serve. Adding a city means adding an
entry here and nothing else: the camera ingestion and the Valhalla
tile build both read this file, so the geography is written once.
bbox is [south, west, north, east] in degrees, the order Overpass
expects. It bounds the camera query and clips the routing tiles, so
cover everywhere a trip might route through, not just the city.
osm_extracts are the Geofabrik downloads the routing tiles are built
from. List every state or country the bbox touches; they get clipped
to the bbox and merged, so overlap is fine and being generous is

fairfax-herndon.description: The original test area. Small enough to iterate on quickly.

dmv.description: Northern Virginia, DC and Maryland. The first real serving area.

dc-ny.description: The Washington to New York corridor.

east-coast.description: Florida to Maine. Measured at 40,546 cameras and about an hour of nightly Overpass, which is more than the free public instance should be asked for. Needs a self-hosted Overpass or Geofabrik extracts filtered with osmium tags-filter, and a tile build far larger than one machine wants.
